title: UK relative-recovery test
reading: Broad hiring shows tentative stabilization, while graduate and first-job routes remain weaker. That divergence is suggestive, not yet decisive.

broad_market.label: ONS vacancies
broad_market.detail: May–July 2026 vacancies were 707,000, down 19,000 from a year earlier but broadly flat through 2026.

broad_market.label: REC active postings
broad_market.detail: REC reported 1.67 million active postings in July 2026, while cautioning that many entry-level opportunities had not recovered to the same extent.

broad_market.label: Permanent placements
broad_market.detail: The KPMG/REC Report on Jobs said permanent placements stabilized after 45 consecutive months of decline.

first_rung.label: Graduate postings
first_rung.detail: Indeed reported graduate postings around 7% below a year earlier and at their weakest point for this time of year since 2020.

first_rung.label: Summer jobs
first_rung.detail: Indeed reported summer-job postings at a four-year low, weakening another route through which young people gain workplace experience.

first_rung.label: LinkedIn entry hiring
first_rung.detail: Across five countries, entry-level hiring was only modestly weaker than overall hiring, but junior hiring in AI-augmented occupations ran 3–10 percentage points below occupation-wide hiring.
